_comment: The risk-adjustment / classification family taxonomy as DATA (data-is-not-code). CMS-HCC is ONE family of several - enumerating them here makes that explicit and data-driven. Each family names its program, population, steward, canonical system, and the registry asset id of its active model version (versions/currency live in registry/data/terminology-assets.json). This is reference metadata, NOT the code-to-group content (which the crosswalk seed answers).

families.name: CDPS
families.steward: UC San Diego / state Medicaid programs
